headline: Motorola Signature 27 debuts with Snapdragon 8 Elite Extreme Gen 6, guarantees 7 OS upgrades
summary: The new Motorola Signature 27 features the Snapdragon 8 Elite Extreme Gen 6 Mobile Platform and guarantees seven OS upgrades. It also includes Audio by Bang & Olufsen, marking a new partnership.
details: The Motorola Signature 27 has debuted, featuring the newly revealed Snapdragon 8 Elite Extreme Gen 6 Mobile Platform. This powerful chip is built on 2nm TSMC and designed with advanced packaging for superior thermal performance.

Running Android 17, the Signature 27 stands out with Motorola's guarantee of seven OS upgrades and seven years of security updates. This commitment aims to provide long-term software support for users.

Motorola states the Signature 27 is expected to launch worldwide in 2026, with more details on availability to follow. Its naming convention, '27', signifies its expected release year of 2027, according to the company.

To manage the demands of AI and gaming, the Signature 27 incorporates an ArcticMesh cooling system. This system includes a new diamond-infused thermal gel, liquid metal, copper mesh, and a redesigned 3D vapor chamber.

The camera setup boasts a 50MP Sony LYTIA 910 main sensor and a 200MP periscope telephoto lens for detailed distant shots. Motorola's Video Enhancement Engine uses AI to automatically adjust color tones during recording.

The Signature 27 is the first Motorola phone to feature Audio by B&O, a result of a recent partnership with Bang & Olufsen. Its premium design combines aluminum with a smooth ceramic and brushed aluminum camera housing.

Available in two distinct finishes, the Pantone Coal Smoke version offers a tactical weave for enhanced grip. The Pantone Capulet Green features a soft, brushed finish, drawing inspiration from high-end fashion and interior design.
